name: The Restless Dead

specialRules.name: Undead skills
specialRules.text: Liches and Necromancers may use this Skill list instead of any standard list (Special): Corpse Bomb: Secretly nominate one Zombie at the start of the battle. If the enemy charges or is charged by it, it detonates: all models within D6" take D3 Strength 4 hits. Zombies killed by shooting do not detonate. One at a time, though both Necromancer and Liche may take the skill. Deathspeaker: At the start of the battle deploy D3 Zombies for free. They do not count toward the maximum model count but increase warband rating; cannot be Corpse Bombs; last only for the battle. Wraith Touch: Instead of normal attacks, makes a single unarmed Wraith Touch that wounds automatically if it hits. A Liche that wounds may regain one lost wound (not above starting total); Necromancers do not. No effect on the Possessed or Undead. Forbidden Rite: If the hero did not search for rare items last exploration phase, he starts the next battle with a pool of D3+1 (+1) modifiers to add to casting rolls, as many as desired at a time. Summoner: Maximum warband size is increased by 1.

specialRules.name: Necromancy
specialRules.text: Necromancy spells: Spell of Awakening (Auto), Lifestealer (10), Reanimation (5), Spell of Doom (9), Call of Vanhel (6), Deathly Visage (Necromancers only, 6), Living Horror (Liche only, 8). See Necromancy list; Liche starts with two random spells, Necromancer one of the Liche's two.

specialRules.name: Animated Construct
specialRules.text: Controlled by the Liche or the Necromancer (recorded on the roster), each controlling one at a time; only a warband with both Liche and Necromancer may have two Scarecrows. If the controller cannot participate the Scarecrow cannot either. If the controller loses a wound, he must pass an unmodified Leadership test or the bond is broken and the Scarecrow is taken out of action.

fighters.notes: Printed T is 3(6): T3 normally, counts as T6 vs shooting/magic missiles. Max 2 (one per Liche/Necromancer controller). Henchman section; starting experience not given (0).

conversionNotes: Wight Blades: to-hit 6 -> natural 12. Flammable: 'fire' on 3+ -> 5+ (normal 4+ -> 7+).
The Liche may not carry non-magical weapons: modelled as a separate armour-only equipment list (liche-armour), not a list in the PDF.

Necromancy spell list is D6-based (Spell of Doom 'roll equal or less than Strength on D6', Living Horror D6+3, Reanimation, Spell of Awakening '11-15 on serious injury chart'); not converted, spell list only referenced by name. Forbidden Rite D3+1 and Corpse Bomb D3/D6 also unchanged.
Scarecrow T printed 3(6); stored T3 with the T6-vs-shooting rule in text.
Buckler appears in the PDF equipment list (armour section).
Scarecrows and Skeletons/Zombies: PDF gives no starting experience for them; 0 assumed. Scarecrow bought as henchman, max 2 (one per controller).
Experience chart maxima: Liche M5 WS4 BS4 S4 T4 W8 I6 A3 Ld10; Grave Guard M5 WS5 BS5 S4 T4 W4 I5 A4 Ld10 (only given for these two).
Warband max is 12 (+1 with Summoner skill).
